faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AYCL Asst. Officer Gr. I (P&A) / Dy. Officer (P&A) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the AYCL Asst. Officer Gr. I (P&A) / Dy. Officer (P&A) Recruitment 2026 is 17 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate Degree/Diploma in Human Resource Management/Personnel Management/Industrial Relation/Labor Welfare. A Post-Graduate Degree/Diploma in the same fields of one-year duration is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the AYCL Asst. Officer Gr. I (P&A) / Dy. Officer (P&A) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 38 years for Grade S2 and 40 years for Grade S3. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Asst. Officer Gr. I (P&A) / Dy. Officer (P&A) in Andrew Yule & Company Limited.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. No other mode of submission will be accepted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Asst. Officer Gr. I (P&A) / Dy. Officer (P&A) post?
faq.answer: The salary is approximately Rs. 0.43 lakh per month for S2 and Rs. 0.47 lakh per month for S3, inclusive of allowances. The annual package is around Rs. 6.20 to 6.64 lakh.

faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by Andrew Yule & Company Limited for this recruitment drive.
